package fixture

// Flagged: the value lands between quotes the literal supplies.
func badString(sha string) string {
	return `{"ref":"refs/heads/main","after":"` + sha + `"}`
}

// Flagged too, and worse: a fragment carrying a quote or a backslash reshapes
// the document rather than one string.
func badFragment(fragment string) string {
	return `{"conclusion":` + fragment + `}`
}

// Not flagged: not JSON.
func notJSON(name string) string {
	return "assets/" + name + ".js"
}

// Not flagged: constant JSON.
func constant() string {
	return `{"conclusion":null}`
}
